newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Gerdau to double Piratini unit output.
newsitem.headline: Gerdau to double Piratini unit output.

text.p: Brazil's Gerdau group said it will invest $65 million to double output capacity at its Piratini plant to 240,000 tonnes of rolled steel from 120,000 tonnes.

The group said in a statement that expansion of the Siderurgica Acos Finos Piratini is the second phase of an ongoing modernization drive, which will include installation of the most modern steel bar rolling mill in Brazil.

Gerdau has invested $227 million in the Piratini plant since its purchase in February 1992. Since then, productivity there has risen to 140 tonnes per man per year from 70 tonnes, it said. Phase Two will double that again to 280 tonnes, it added.
The group's President Jorge Gerdau Johannpeter is scheduled to formally announce the latest expansion Thursday at a ceremony in Chaqueadas, Brazil.
